en-us.crane_machine_empty: $doer.firstname$ peers into the machine - it has been cleaned out.
en-us.crane_intro:
$doer.firstname$ leans in close to the glass and sizes up the prizes:
$crane_grid$
en-us.crane_q_x: First move the claw sideways - which column?
en-us.crane_q_y: Now move it forward or back - which row?
en-us.crane_x_ok:
$crane_aim_text$
$doer.firstname$ slides the claw neatly over the chosen column.
en-us.crane_x_slip:
$crane_aim_text$
The stick slips, and the claw drifts off its line.
en-us.crane_x_random: $doer.firstname$ flicks the stick without much thought, and the claw wobbles sideways.
en-us.crane_y_ok:
$crane_aim_text$
$doer.firstname$ lines the claw up with the row they wanted.
en-us.crane_y_slip:
$crane_aim_text$
The button gets pressed too early, and the claw stops off the mark.
en-us.crane_y_random: $doer.firstname$ slaps the button without looking, and the claw sways to a stop.
en-us.crane_cell_empty_line: The claw drops onto $crane_cell_name$ and closes on thin air - nothing there.
en-us.crane_grab_one:
$crane_grab_text$
The claw drops onto $crane_cell_name$, clamps $crane_prize$ and carries it to the chute!
en-us.crane_grab_all:
$crane_grab_text$
Critical success! The claw drops onto $crane_cell_name$ and scoops up everything: $crane_prize$!
en-us.crane_grab_miss:
$crane_grab_text$
The claw drops onto $crane_cell_name$ and catches a prize, but lets go on the way up.
en-us.crane_grab_lost: The claw drops onto $crane_cell_name$, but the prizes there are already gone.
